title: Unwrapped Flesh
description:
Informed by the studies from the lines of Blaschko (who mapped the normally imperceptible patterns within human skin), the seams articulated across the membrane surface reveal the concealed logic of its formation, translating an internal developmental pathway into visible forms. 
The membrane is intended as a second skin generated by the altered organism itself.

Modelled in Zbrush and Maya, rendered in Arnold.
